Candidate = 10 Hz head reading step |dp_h,i| > 100 bar (record meas.head_pressure) with the crawler lifted in the period before (phase not idle / check / touch / fault, the run without a pressure-sensor fault injection); r_k = sum F_hat_cal - M_eff (f_z - (alpha x r_C1)_z), F_hat_cal = s8_series F_nominal_N (F_hat_N where NaN), f_z = r8 imu_samples[k, -1, 2], alpha = (gyro[k, -1] - gyro[k, -2]) / T_imu from r8 imu_gyro_samples (C-S8-31; absent in older records -> uncorrected), r_C1 = IMU C1 - superstructure COM of the run's level; M_eff = READY median (last stay, 60 s, >= 3 samples), else the YAML superstructure mass; ratio = |r_k - r_k-1| / (|dp_h,i| A_p,i). F_s grade = run mean of the per-leg pads F_seal_limit maximum.
